description: For a Live Visit Feed site: one visit's last feed event, as stored. Pass the `visit_id` a feed event or list_live_visits carries. It needs an API key from the developer console, which holds the visits permission, and the feed turned on for the site; a conversion site's credential is refused with not_feed_site. `as_of` says when the event was built. A visit's event is stored at an exit signal, at a conversion and when the visit ends, so for a visit still in progress it can be minutes old, and a visit just listed can answer not_found until then. A very long narrative keeps its last 2,000 characters. `preview_score` is a score trained on purchases, not on the site's goals, and is null unless the site turned scoring on; `interest` is null in the preview. `control_group: true` marks the permanent holdout: Cromanion never acts on those visits, and the feed still describes them. A visit later judged a bot keeps the event it was sent. 60 calls an hour per key; every call is on the developer's record before it runs.
